title: Transmission line current
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the current in the transmission line using the power loss and line resistance, arriving at 10 A.

title: Step-up turns ratio
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the transformer turns ratio using the generator and transmission line currents, arriving at 1:50.

title: Power loss calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly identify and calculate the 10% power loss from the generator's output power.

title: Generator current calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the primary (generator side) current using the generator's output power and voltage.

title: Applying transformer principle
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the ideal transformer current-to-turns ratio relationship (I1/I2 = N2/N1).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work should demonstrate consistent use of units (e.g., kW to W) throughout the calculations.

title: Incorrect power formula
description: Pitfall: Using P = I^2 * R with the generator's voltage/current to find the transmission line current, instead of the power loss.

title: Reversed turns ratio
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly inverting the transformer ratio (e.g., stating 50:1 instead of 1:50) by confusing the voltage and current relationships.
